title: Martial Arts Software With a Branded App: Costs (2026)
description: Martial arts software with a branded app and what it costs: Zen Planner $39/mo, PushPress $97/mo, Gymdesk $100/mo, plus Spark, Wodify and MatPilot.
h1: Martial arts software with a branded app
keyword: martial arts software with branded app
body:
A branded app puts your school's name and logo on your students' phones, with its own listing in the App Store and Google Play, instead of sending them to the software company's generic app. Most martial arts software already includes a student app. The branded version is usually a paid add-on, and some vendors don't publish what it costs.

We checked each vendor's own public pages on November 13, 2026 and list only what they publish. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown. We have not used these tools ourselves and we don't publish ratings.

Tools with a published branded app price

  • Zen Planner: the cheapest published add-on we found at $39/mo. Staff and member mobile apps are already included, and Studio runs from $99/mo (0-45 active members) to $289/mo (251+). Belt and skill tracking is listed. {{aff:zenplanner|See Zen Planner pricing}}
  • Gymdesk: a branded member app with your gym's own App Store and Google Play listing for $100/mo, first month free. Plans start at $75/mo with Gymdesk Payments (up to 50 active members) and include unlimited staff and a gym website. {{aff:gymdesk|See Gymdesk pricing}}
  • PushPress: the Branded App add-on is $97/mo and is fully white-labeled with your branding and logo, member check-ins, class booking, workout history and push notifications. Because the PushPress Free plan is $0/mo, this is the lowest total we found for a white-labeled app ($97/mo), but the Free plan's card rate is 4.99% + $0.30. On its pricing page PushPress also lists a Black Friday offer of 30% off any product, including the Branded App, for the first 6 months if you sign up by December 11, 2026. Rank Tracking is listed. {{aff:pushpress|See PushPress pricing}}

Brandable app included, full white-label priced on request

  • Spark Membership: the Spark Member App comes with the $199/mo plan (8-week free trial). Spark's FAQ says you can add your logo, images, brand colours and content without a developer, and a fully white-labeled version is available "for a small additional cost" through your account rep. That price isn't published.
  • Wodify: one app for clients and staff, with Custom Branding listed across the app, sales pages and POS. A Branded App ("your own app in the App Store") is an add-on on every plan, but the price isn't published.
  • MatPilot: native iOS and Android apps are included on Free ($0 + 2% of payments) and Pro ($79/mo + 0.49%). A white-label app is "quoted by scope", with no list price.

Standard app only (no branded option mentioned)

  • Martialytics: a free Student App on every plan, from $69/mo (0-50 students), with every feature on every tier. A branded app isn't mentioned on its pricing page. {{aff:martialytics|See Martialytics plans}}
  • MatGoat: native iOS and Android apps included at no extra cost on Basic ($40/mo, up to 50 students) and Professional ($60/mo, unlimited).
  • Kicksite: the Member Portal is a mobile web app where students or guardians view schedules, register, manage payment methods and check in with an in-app barcode. From $49/mo (0-25 students).
  • MAAT and Dojo Champ also have student apps (Dojo Champ told us it has native iOS and Android apps). Neither publishes a branded app option, so ask during the trial.

Do you need a branded app?

  • Probably not at first. Every tool above already gives students a way to book, pay and check in from a phone. Adding a branded app costs $39 to $100+ a month among the vendors that publish a price.
  • It can help if you run several locations, sell gear or private lessons through the app, or want push notifications to come from your own school name.
  • Before you pay, ask: who owns the App Store listing, what happens to it if you cancel, whether there's a setup fee, and how long Apple and Google review takes. None of the vendors above publish these details.

faq: Which martial arts software has a branded app?

Of the tools we checked on 2026-11-13, Zen Planner ($39/mo add-on), PushPress ($97/mo add-on) and Gymdesk ($100/mo add-on, first month free) publish a price for a branded app. Spark Membership, Wodify and MatPilot offer a white-labeled or branded app but don't publish its price.
What is the cheapest way to get a branded app for a martial arts school?

PushPress's Free plan ($0/mo) plus its $97/mo Branded App add-on is the lowest published total we found, but the Free plan's card rate is 4.99% + $0.30. Zen Planner Studio at $99/mo plus its $39/mo branded app comes to $138/mo for up to 45 active members (pricing pages checked 2026-11-13).
Do students need a branded app to book classes?

No. Zen Planner, Gymdesk, PushPress, Spark, Wodify, MatPilot, Martialytics and MatGoat all list a standard student or member app, and Kicksite's Member Portal is a mobile web app. The branded version mainly changes the name and logo students see.

Spark says you can add your logo, images, brand colours and content to the Spark Member App, and a fully white-labeled version costs a "small additional cost" that isn't published (sparkmembership.com/app FAQ, checked 2026-11-13).
